sections.title: Pieces of Heart
sections.note: Game Boy and DX: 12 pieces, every four make a heart. Tags give the items you need.

items.name: Mabe Village well
items.area: Well, west of Marin and Tarin's house
items.howTo: Go two screens west of Marin and Tarin's house, cut the middle of the three bushes above the cliff and jump into the well. The piece is in the cave below.

items.name: Fishing Pond: the big fish
items.area: Fishing Pond, two screens north of Madam MeowMeow's
items.howTo: Pay 10 Rupees and catch the heaviest fish, the one lurking under the cliff. Clearing out the small fish first usually helps.
items.notes: The Switch remake adds a second Piece of Heart here for a small fish.

items.name: Ring of pits
items.howTo: Leave the Mysterious Forest to the east: the piece sits inside a ring of pits. Jump over them.

items.name: Toadstool cave skulls
items.area: Cave on the way to the Toadstool
items.howTo: In the cave you pass through to reach the Toadstool, lift the two skulls that block the piece.

items.name: Crystal cave
items.area: East of Mabe Village, near the Pincer pits
items.howTo: Bomb the cracked wall at the upper left. Inside, dash through the crystals with the Pegasus Boots, then bomb the hidden east wall.

items.name: Flooded cave east of Angler's Tunnel
items.area: Three screens east of Angler's Tunnel
items.howTo: Swim three screens east of Angler's Tunnel into a cave and dive.

items.name: Kanalet Castle moat
items.area: Moat, just west of the front gate
items.howTo: Get into the moat by the stairs at the north-east corner, swim round to just west of the front gate and dive.

items.name: Lanmola's quicksand cave
items.howTo: Beat the Desert Lanmola and let the quicksand swallow you (or bomb the entrance one screen east), then bomb the cave's north wall.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's Switch guide also lists the Ocarina; no other source does.

items.name: Cemetery cave
items.howTo: Push the bottom-right of the four graves in the south-west of the Cemetery, or take the stairs south of the Witch's Hut. Cross the platforms with a diagonal jump, or bomb the block and Hookshot over.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon needs only Roc's Feather; Zelda's Palace gives the Pegasus Boots or Hookshot.

items.name: Cave north-east of Animal Village
items.howTo: Bomb the cracked wall, then the cave's north wall. Throw a bomb over the fence at the cracked block (or fire a Bomb Arrow), go round and Hookshot across.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon also lists Roc's Feather and the Bow.

items.name: Broken bridge west of the Hen House
items.howTo: Hookshot across the broken bridge, cut the bush to find stairs, bomb the south wall and go one room right.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's Game Boy page puts it in Tal Tal Heights.

items.name: Turtle Rock ledge
items.area: Turtle Rock (Level 8), the north-west "left arm" room
items.howTo: In Turtle Rock's north-west room, take the stairs outside onto a ledge of the mountain. The piece is there.

sections.title: Heart Containers
sections.note: One from each dungeon's Nightmare, in every version.

items.name: Moldorm
items.howTo: Beat the boss of Tail Cave.
items.notes: In the original you can't leave the boss room without it; on Switch it can be left behind.

items.name: Genie
items.howTo: Beat the boss of Bottle Grotto.
items.notes: In the original you can't leave the boss room without it; on Switch it can be left behind.

items.name: Slime Eye
items.howTo: Beat the boss of Key Cavern.
items.notes: In the original you can't leave the boss room without it; on Switch it can be left behind.

items.name: Angler Fish
items.howTo: Beat the boss of Angler's Tunnel.
items.notes: In the original you can't leave the boss room without it; on Switch it can be left behind.

items.name: Slime Eel
items.howTo: Beat the boss of Catfish's Maw.
items.notes: In the original you can't leave the boss room without it; on Switch it can be left behind.

items.name: Facade
items.howTo: Beat the boss of Face Shrine.
items.notes: In the original you can't leave the boss room without it; on Switch it can be left behind.

items.name: Evil Eagle
items.howTo: Beat the boss of Eagle's Tower.
items.notes: In the original you can't leave the boss room without it; on Switch it can be left behind.

items.name: Hot Head
items.howTo: Beat the boss of Turtle Rock.
items.notes: In the original you can't leave the boss room without it; on Switch it can be left behind.

sections.title: Switch Pieces of Heart
sections.note: The 2019 Switch remake: 32 pieces (the original 12 and 20 new). Counted apart from the Game Boy and DX total.

items.name: Mabe Village well
items.area: Well, west of Marin and Tarin's house
items.howTo: Cut the bushes above the well on the west side of the village and jump in.
items.notes: Also in the Game Boy and DX versions.

items.name: Trendy Game: first piece
items.howTo: Win it from the crane game. It's on offer from the start, alongside the Yoshi Doll.
items.notes: 10 Rupees a go.

items.name: Fishing Pond: a small fish
items.howTo: Pay 10 Rupees and catch a small fish.

items.name: Fishing Pond: the big fish
items.howTo: Pay 10 Rupees and catch a large fish.
items.notes: Also in the Game Boy and DX versions.

items.name: Ring of pits
items.howTo: Jump into the ring of pits just east of the Mysterious Forest.
items.notes: Also in the Game Boy and DX versions.

items.name: Line of pits
items.area: North-east corner, south of Dampé's Shack
items.howTo: Jump the line of pits in the north-east corner, north of the Cemetery.

items.name: Toadstool cave skulls
items.area: Cave on the way to the Toadstool
items.howTo: In the third room of the Toadstool cave, push the blocks and lift the skulls.
items.notes: Also in the Game Boy and DX versions.

items.name: Town Tool Shop
items.howTo: Buy it for 200 Rupees.

items.name: Skull cave east of Mabe
items.area: North-west cave, just east of Mabe Village
items.howTo: Solve the push-block puzzle and lift the skull.

items.name: Seashell Mansion: 5 seashells
items.howTo: Bring 5 Secret Seashells to the Seashell Mansion.
items.notes: Also in Secret Seashells, as the Switch Mansion's first reward.

items.name: Crystal cave north of Dampé's
items.area: Cave behind rocks, north of Dampé's Shack
items.howTo: Break the crystal and push the blocks.
items.notes: Nintendo Life also lists Roc's Feather.

items.name: Pothole Field gap
items.howTo: Give Richard the five Golden Leaves to open the way, then jump the two-hole gap in the north-east corner.
items.notes: A running jump with the Pegasus Boots helps (Zelda Dungeon, Nintendo Life); Zelda's Palace says it's needed.

items.name: Crystal cave
items.howTo: Bomb the wall north-east of the warp point, dash through the black barriers and bomb the cracked east wall.
items.notes: Also in the Game Boy and DX versions.

items.name: Behind Animal Village
items.howTo: The piece is in plain sight. Walk north from where the Walrus lay and round behind the houses.

items.name: Lanmola's quicksand cave
items.howTo: Sink into the quicksand after the Lanmola fight and bomb the cave's north wall.
items.notes: Also in the Game Boy and DX versions.

items.name: Dampé: Fill Up Your Hearts
items.howTo: Clear Dampé's "Fill Up Your Hearts" Chamber Dungeon challenge (Tier 1).
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon and Nintendo Life. Zelda's Palace ties it to the first four challenges, and Zelda Wiki to the fourth Level 2 challenge.

items.name: Trendy Game: second piece
items.howTo: Win it from the upper platform once the Yoshi Doll, the first Piece of Heart, the seashell and the Chamber Stone are gone.

items.name: Flooded cave east of Angler's Tunnel
items.howTo: Swim east from Angler's Tunnel into the flooded cave and dive.
items.notes: Also in the Game Boy and DX versions.

items.name: Kanalet Castle moat
items.area: Moat, just west of the front gate
items.howTo: Dive in the moat just west of the front gate.
items.notes: Also in the Game Boy and DX versions.

items.name: Martha's Bay channel
items.area: Narrow channel at the south end
items.howTo: Dive in the narrow water channel at the south end of the bay.

items.name: Martha's Bay stair cave
items.area: Stairs ringed by bushes at the south end
items.howTo: Past a two-hole gap, cut into the bushes round the stairs and dive in the flooded cave below.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon uses the Pegasus Boots for the gap; Zelda's Palace cuts the bushes with the Boomerang or Fire Rod; Nintendo Life says a jump-slash works.

items.name: Tunnel south of the Mansion
items.howTo: In the tunnel south of the Seashell Mansion toward Animal Village, dive.

items.name: Cave north-east of Animal Village
items.howTo: Bomb into the cave, bomb the block over the fence and Hookshot across.
items.notes: Also in the Game Boy and DX versions.

items.name: Cave behind three rocks
items.howTo: Hookshot to the rock and push it.
items.notes: Nintendo Life also lists the Power Bracelet.

items.name: Cemetery cave
items.howTo: Take the stairs south of the Witch's Hut, or push the grave, and cross the platforms.
items.notes: Also in the Game Boy and DX versions. Zelda Dungeon: Roc's Feather, Hookshot optional; Nintendo Life: Bombs and Pegasus Boots; Zelda's Palace: Boots or Hookshot.

items.name: Dampé: Tier 2 challenges
items.howTo: Clear all of Dampé's Tier 2 challenges: Key Hunter, Bombs Away!, Treasure Vault and Passageway Central.

items.name: Rapids Ride cave
items.area: Cave by the raft shop, north-east of the Face Shrine
items.howTo: Follow the cave by the raft owner's hut and Hookshot across.

items.name: Rapids Ride: west islet
items.area: Island on the far west of the rapids
items.howTo: On a free ride (100 Rupees), go far west, drop down and hug the west wall to an island; Hookshot to the vines.

items.name: Rapids Race
items.howTo: Finish the Rapids Race in under 40 seconds.
items.notes: 40 s per Zelda Dungeon and Nintendo Life; Zelda's Palace says 45 s. The race costs 100 Rupees.

items.name: Broken bridge west of the Hen House
items.howTo: Hookshot over the broken bridge, cut the bush hiding the stairs, bomb the south wall and go right.
items.notes: Also in the Game Boy and DX versions.

items.name: Ledge past the rockfall
items.howTo: Past the rockfall field with the Like Like and Shrouded Stalfos, take the narrow south-west ledge west.

items.name: Turtle Rock ledge
items.howTo: In the north-west Vire room of Turtle Rock, take the stairs outside to a ledge.
items.notes: Also in the Game Boy and DX versions.

sections.title: Switch Heart Container
sections.note: The remake's one extra Heart Container, from Dampé.

items.name: Dampé: Ticking Clock
items.howTo: Clear Dampé's twelfth and last challenge, "Ticking Clock" (Tier 3), after the other eleven.
items.notes: A full Heart Container, not a piece: with it the remake reaches 20 hearts. Dampé's Chamber Dungeons (the Panel Dungeon in Japan) are Switch-only: you lay out Chamber Stones of rooms from the island's dungeons and clear his challenges.
